newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann wins major steel pipe contract.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann wins major steel pipe contract.

text.p: Germany's Mannesmann AG said on Wednesday it won a contract to supply Russian natural gas supplier Gasprom with 917,000 tonnes of steel pipe.
Industry sources said the contract had a value of 900 million marks.
The order is the largest Mannesmann has ever had for large diameter pipe. Gazprom planned to use it for the Yamal natural gas pipeline.
Mannesmann has already delivered 148,000 tonnes of pipe to Gazprom under a contract awarded in June 1996.
Mannesmann's steel tubes operations, after struggling with a succession of losses, turned a profit in the quarter that ended March 31.
The unit's first-quarter sales rose seven percent to 1.7 billion marks, while orders rose 27 percent to 2.2 billion marks.
